test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is primarily responsible for the movement of the human body?

options.text: Combination of nervous and connective tissues
Combination of nervous and epithelial tissues
Combination of muscular and connective tissues
Combination of nervous and muscular tissues

solution:
The correct answer is __**combination of nervous and muscular tissues**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Animals can move quickly in reaction to stimuli thanks to both their muscular and neurological systems.**
 
• **Neurons** take in a **stimulus** and send it on to the **brain and spinal cord for processing.**
 
• **Motor neurons** then transmit the response impulse back to the effector organ, which is typically a muscle in most situations.
 
• **Muscles respond to an impulse by moving in the desired direction.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Connective tissue**

 
 
• **Supporting tissue protects and supports the body's other tissues and organs.**
 
• In addition to helping to transport nutrients and other substances between tissues and organs, connective tissue also helps to store fat and mend damaged tissue.
 
• **A gel-like substance, fibres, and cells make up connective tissue.**
 
 
 
• **Epithelial tissue**
 
 
• The** epithelium is a type of body tissue that covers all of the internal and exterior body surfaces**, lines hollow organs and body cavities, and makes up the majority of **glandular tissue.**
 
 
 
• **Muscular tissue**
 
 
• **Specialized cells called muscle fibres make up the muscular system. Its primary characteristic is its capacity to contract.**
 
• Muscles that are attached to bones, internal organs, or blood arteries are what move things.
 
• **Skeletal, smooth, and cardiac muscle tissue are the three different types of muscle tissue.**
